LanguageData.Rawcloudberry.label: 云莓
LanguageData.Rawcloudberry.description: 云莓是一种琥珀色、甜美、类似覆盆子的小果实。生吃非常美味。
LanguageData.RawOlives.label: Olives
LanguageData.RawOlives.description: The primary use for olives is for oil which can be used as fuel or in cooking. They taste very bitter unless they are fermented.
